name: Rotorua
tagline: Geysers, Māori culture and bubbling mud
summary: Rotorua is New Zealand's geothermal heartland, smelling faintly of sulphur, with spouting geysers, rainbow-coloured hot pools and a living Māori culture. Watch Pōhutu geyser erupt, join a hāngī feast, soak in hot springs and mountain-bike the giant redwoods.
seasonNote: Summer is warm; the steam looks even more dramatic in winter.
arrival: Rotorua Airport is 10 minutes away; Auckland is a 3-hour drive.
gettingAround: A car is best; tours pick up from hotels.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry a little cash for rural honesty boxes.
